buyr.intro: The one looking for a specific piece, handing the search over to the community.
buyr.i1: Posts a detailed search with inspiration photos and a budget
buyr.i2: Receives proposals from findrs who tracked the item down
buyr.i3: Picks the best offer and completes the purchase safely
buyr.i4: Rates the findr on delivery to help the community

findr.title: The findr
findr.intro: The one who goes hunting and digs out the requested piece, wherever it hides.
findr.i1: Browses searches and spots the ones they can deliver on
findr.i2: Hunts actively in flea markets, thrift shops, garage sales, online…
findr.i3: Sends a proposal with photos, price and a detailed description
findr.i4: Earns a commission on every successful sale

steps.title: Step by step
steps.showDetails: Show the detail of each step

s1.title: The buyr posts a search
s1.description: A detailed description of the piece, inspiration photos, budget range, urgency level. The sharper the search, the more relevant the proposals.

s2.title: findrs discover and book it
s2.description: findrs browse the open searches. If they believe they can find the item, they can request an exclusive booking to avoid competing while they hunt.

s3.title: The findr sends a proposal
s3.description: Once the item is found, the findr submits a proposal with real photos, the asking price (commission included) and the condition.

s4.title: Negotiation and approval
s4.description: buyr and findr talk through the built-in messaging. The buyr can ask for extra photos, negotiate, or approve the proposal right away.

s5.title: Secure payment
s5.description: The buyr pays securely. Funds are held until the item is received and approved — protection for both sides.

s6.title: Shipping and delivery
s6.description: The findr ships the item with tracking. On arrival, the buyr confirms everything matches. The funds are then released to the findr.

s7.title: Mutual rating
s7.description: Both sides rate each other. Those reviews build reputation and trust across the community.

reservation.title: The booking system
reservation.why1: Avoid several findrs hunting the same item
reservation.why2: Invest time in the hunt with peace of mind
reservation.how1: The findr requests a booking for a set duration
reservation.how2: The buyr approves, adjusts or declines the request
reservation.how3: The search becomes exclusive for that duration

etiquette.title: findr good manners
etiquette.intro: A few simple rules to keep the experience great for everyone.

r1.title: Respect and kindness
r1.description: Every member deserves respect. Keep exchanges courteous, even when you disagree.

r2.title: Clear communication
r2.description: Reply to messages within a reasonable window (24-48h). Be precise in your descriptions.

r3.title: Honesty
r3.description: Describe item condition faithfully. Bad surprises damage everyone's trust.

r4.title: Reliability
r4.description: Honour your commitments: booking, shipping and reply times. Speak up if something comes up.

r5.title: Fair ratings
r5.description: Rate constructively. A negative review should be justified and factual.

r6.title: No off-platform deals
r6.description: Every transaction must go through findr so everyone stays protected.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how findr collects, uses and protects your personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and French data protection law.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.text: The data controller is findr SAS. If you have any questions, contact us at <email>privacy@findrapp.fr</email>.

data.title: 2. Data we collect
data.identity: Identification data: first name, last name, email address and encrypted password.
data.usage: Usage data: published searches, proposals, messages and ratings.
data.technical: Technical data: IP address, browser type and connection logs.

purposes.title: 3. How we use your data
purposes.security: Keep the Platform secure and prevent fraud.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal basis
legalBasis.text: We process data to perform our contract with you (the Terms), based on your consent for marketing communications, and for findr's legitimate interests in security and improving the service.

retention.title: 5. Data retention
retention.text: We keep your data for as long as needed to provide the service, and for no more than three years after your last activity unless a longer legal retention period applies, particularly for accounting records.

recipients.title: 6. Who receives your data
recipients.text: Your data may be accessed by authorised findr team members and by our technical service providers, including hosting and payment providers, under strict contractual obligations. We never sell your data to third parties.

rights.title: 7. Your rights
rights.text: You have the right to access, correct, erase and transfer your data, restrict its processing, and object to its use. You can exercise these rights at <email>privacy@findrapp.fr</email>. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority (<cnil>www.cnil.fr</cnil>).

cookies.title: 8. Cookies
cookies.text: findr only uses cookies that are strictly necessary for the Platform to work, including session and authentication cookies. No advertising or third-party tracking cookies are placed without your consent.

security.title: 9. Security
security.text: We use appropriate technical and organisational safeguards, including encryption, access controls and backups, to protect your data from unauthorised access, loss or alteration.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern the findr platform, which connects people looking for an item or service (“buyrs”) with people who can source it for them (“findrs”).

purpose.title: 1. Purpose
purpose.text: findr is a platform that connects users. findr is not a seller, buyer or commercial intermediary. Transactions are entered into directly between buyrs and findrs within the framework provided by the Platform.

registration.title: 2. Registration
registration.text: Registration is free and limited to adults who have the legal capacity to enter into a contract. Users agree to provide accurate information and keep it up to date.

matching.title: 3. How matching works
matching.search: Buyrs publish a search describing the item or service they want.
matching.payment: The buyr may accept a proposal, at which point the funds are held securely by the Platform (escrow).
matching.release: Funds are released to the findr once the buyr confirms receipt.

fees.title: 4. Service fees
fees.text: findr charges a 5% fee on each successful transaction (reduced to 3% for Premium members), plus a 3% authentication fee. All fees are clearly shown before a transaction is confirmed.

obligations.title: 5. User responsibilities
obligations.content: Do not publish illegal, counterfeit or misleading content.
obligations.commitments: Honour all commitments made as part of a transaction.
obligations.messaging: Communicate exclusively through the built-in messaging service until the transaction is complete.

suspension.title: 6. Suspension and termination
suspension.text: findr reserves the right to suspend or delete any account that breaches these Terms, without notice or compensation.

liability.title: 7. Liability
liability.text: findr acts as a technical intermediary. The findr alone is responsible for the conformity, authenticity and delivery of the items or services offered. The buyr is responsible for payment.

personalData.title: 8. Personal data
personalData.text: Our handling of personal data is explained in our <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.

law.title: 9. Governing law
law.text: These Terms are governed by French law. Any dispute will fall within the jurisdiction of the competent courts for findr’s registered office, subject to any mandatory consumer protection rules.
